indexing.rationale: This is a public specification suite intended for wide review and citation. Making it discoverable is the point.

summarization.rationale: Explaining a specification to a reader serves the specification. No boundary is crossed by describing what 430 and AIBDP do.

question_answering.rationale: Answering questions from these documents is equivalent to a reader consulting them directly.

embedding.rationale: Retrieval over public standards text supports the same discovery goal as indexing.

conditions: Attribution to the author and to this repository must be preserved and reproducible in outputs derived from this corpus.
Derived works reproducing substantial prose must honour CC-BY-SA-4.0 (documentation) and MPL-2.0 (source), the licences this repository is published under.
training.rationale: Not a refusal. The condition is exactly what the repository's own licences already require of any other reuse; AIBDP restates it in a machine-readable form.
training.alternatives: Cite the Internet-Drafts in drafts/ directly rather than training on the prose.

conditions: Generated text presented as a statement of this protocol must not be attributed to the authors unless it quotes the Internet-Drafts verbatim.
Normative claims about HTTP 430 or AIBDP must cite the draft and section they derive from.
generation.rationale: A specification is defined by its exact wording. Paraphrase presented as the specification misrepresents it — this is the failure mode the protocol exists to name.

conditions: Same attribution and licence conditions as training.
fine_tuning.rationale: Fine-tuning is training with a narrower objective; the same licence terms apply.

conditions: Contact the maintainer before incorporating this corpus into a commercially licensed model.
Attribution and licence conditions from 'training' continue to apply.
commercial_training.rationale: Conditional rather than refused: the aim is a conversation and correct attribution, not exclusion. Consistent with the project's stated position that AIBDP is pro-boundary, not anti-AI.

enforcement.note: This repository is served from GitHub and cannot itself return 430. The manifest is normative; the status code is the enforcement mechanism specified for origins that can emit it.
enforcement.preferred_resolution: Correspondence and correction. The intent is that boundaries are legible, not that they are litigated.

philosophy.note: This manifest is the repository dogfooding its own protocol: the specification for AIBDP is itself published with an AIBDP declaration.
